card.name: Inside grade ranges and CYP3A names
card.fires_on: Short pieces inside a fixed technical label, just before a hyphen or digit continues it. Examples are the 3 in 'Grade 3-4', the A in 'CYP3A', and the 0 before '.85' in a formula.

modes.label: Grade 3-4 ranges
modes.description: The first number of a toxicity grade range such as Grade 3-4, before the hyphen.

modes.label: CYP3A enzyme names
modes.description: The letter A in CYP3A, right before a following 4 or a word like substrates.

modes.label: Numbers in formulas
modes.description: A leading digit inside a calculation, before a decimal part.
